A special thanks to Shifa, who coordinated everything seamlessly from Mumbai over WhatsApp. Having travelled with Seventh Sky Tours multiple times now, we highly recommend them, especially for family travel with kids and elders.

Maldives in 3 Days – A Slice of Paradise

Day 1 – Arrival in Paradise

The moment we landed in the Maldives, the beauty of turquoise lagoons and white sand beaches instantly stole our hearts. A speedboat ride to our resort set the tone for what was to come – crystal-clear water, swaying palms, and a warm welcome from the staff.

After settling into our overwater villa, we spent the afternoon simply soaking in the views from our deck – endless ocean on all sides, fish darting beneath us, and the luxury of doing nothing at all. Evening brought a golden sunset that painted the sky with brilliant hues, followed by a candlelit dinner on the beach. It was the perfect start – slow, romantic, and soul-soothing.

⸻

Day 2 – Underwater Adventures & Sunset Magic

Waking up to the sound of gentle waves was surreal. After a hearty breakfast by the beach, we set out for snorkeling. The underwater world left us awestruck – vibrant corals, schools of colorful fish, and even spotting a graceful sea turtle gliding by. It felt like stepping into another universe, one that humbles you with its beauty.

The afternoon was reserved for leisure – swimming, sunbathing, and enjoying the tranquility of island life. As the sun began to set, we boarded a dolphin cruise. The sight of dolphins leaping beside our boat against the backdrop of a fiery sunset was pure magic. The day ended with a seafood feast under the stars – truly an unforgettable island experience.

⸻

Day 3 – Saying Goodbye, Not Forever

On our last day, we woke early to catch the sunrise – soft pastels filling the horizon, a peaceful silence broken only by the rhythm of waves. We spent the morning kayaking in the calm lagoon and walking along the powdery white sand, making sure to imprint every detail of the island into our memory.

Check-out was bittersweet – while we were excited to take the memories home, a part of us wished we could stay longer in this dreamland. Maldives has a way of slowing down time, letting you live in the moment, and reminding you what paradise truly feels like.

⸻

✨ Final Thoughts:
Three days in the Maldives may not feel like enough, but it’s enough to fall in love. From sunrise to sunset, every moment here feels like a postcard – perfect, serene, and unforgettable. It’s not just a holiday; it’s an experience that stays with you long after you’ve left.

Thanks DJ & Shreya for a wonderful holiday

Our short-notice request was quickly picked up by Adina, and our ideas and changes were incorporated promptly and, where necessary, adapted and improved. We can highly recommend this as well. Treat yourselves to three relaxed and informative hours with Viveka between Horniman Circle Garden and the Gateway of India.

Thank you, India Someday, for everything.

Even though November is considered a good time to visit India, in Delhi, Mumbai, and actually throughout Rajasthan, we hardly ever had clear air.
